title: Average, for small rooms…
text:
Average, for small rooms…. [[VIDEOID:b542cd37500d8e78247be441e2df2b51]] Seems to be energy efficient, yet it didn’t blow much air. After using this, I think it is a small ionization with UV light. For small rooms this could work giving it some time to run and circulate the air. But, in my final opinion this seems way under powered and the UV light is very small. So, in a tight space maybe effective. The biggest plus is that it is very portable!

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Air Angel AA300 Air Purifier for Home, Office, and Car - Energy Efficient Odor Eliminator with Polar Ionization and AHPCO Technology - Indoor Air Purification and Sanitation
features: TOP CLASS AIR PURIFIER - When it comes to air purification, the Air Angel is the way to go! The Air Angel prevents allergies by eliminating germs, allergens, odors, smoke, and other airborne irritants that may potentially disturb your day-to-day life.

HIGH-COVERAGE - The Air Angel's full Polar Ionization and AHPCO technology enables it to filter air in closed areas up to 300 sq. ft. It is more convenient than a HEPA filter, since its design ensures that you don't have to change filters every few months.

SANITIZES MOST SURFACES - This air purifier neutralizes not just the air inside the room but any exposed surface such as tabletops and doorknobs, as well. The Air Angel's round-the-clock sanitization provides a safer environment for contact and inhalation.

COMPACT AND PORTABLE - Unlike a large room air purifier, the Air Angel takes up little space in any room it is placed in. Its subtle but high performance mechanism is perfect for nurseries, living rooms, bedrooms, offices, cars, vehicles, and many other indoor settings.

ACCESSORIES INCLUDED - Along with the Air Angel Air Purifier, each order comes with the following accessories: carrying case, wall adapter, and mounting bracket. (NOTE: the Car Adaptor is not included.)
